biggest_catch: The advertised 'up to $500' bundles four separate bonuses — the real no-strings cash is just $50 (open+fund same day) + $75 ($1,000 in direct deposits within 90 days); the bigger amounts require parking $10,000-$20,000 for 90 days or a separate credit-card spend of $3,000.
catches: $50 checking bonus: membership AND a qualifying checking account must be opened and funded on the same day.
$75 direct deposit bonus: at least $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days; transfers between accounts, ATM deposits, wires, and P2P payments do NOT qualify.
Deposit bonus tiers require a 90-day average daily balance of $1,500+ ($100), $10,000+ ($225), or $20,000+ ($275) — significant balance parking.

Credit-card bonus (10,000 points for $3,000 in purchases within 90 days of opening the myRewards VISA Signature) is a separate credit-card welcome offer requiring a credit pull and spend — not counted in this route's payout range.
Cash bonuses are paid within 90-120 days depending on join date — a long wait; bonuses may be reported to the IRS.
Promotion for NEW memberships only, limited to one per membership; limited time, may be modified/suspended/discontinued at any time without notice.
Membership eligibility: Florida and Georgia (iTHINK Financial is a FL/GA credit union); $5 savings deposit to open membership.

steps: Become a new iTHINK Financial member (Florida/Georgia credit union; $5 savings deposit to open).
Open and fund a qualifying checking account (e.g. myChoice Checking) on the SAME day the membership is opened — earns the $50 checking bonus.
Receive at least $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits (payroll/pension/benefits; not internal transfers, ATM deposits, wires, or P2P) within the first 90 days — earns the $75 DD bonus.
Optionally maintain a 90-day average daily balance of $1,500+ ($100), $10,000+ ($225), or $20,000+ ($275) to earn the deposit bonus tier.
Wait for cash bonuses to be paid within 90-120 days of joining; bonuses may be reported to the IRS.
